environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 sync workers. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer filtering or inspection is applied. SQLite database file is on local EBS volume with standard ext4 filesystem permissions (app user owns the file).

config.database: SQLite on local EBS, /var/lib/app/users.db owned by app user
